mapper.sql: pst_id AS pst_id, bbs_id, ttl AS ttl, cn AS cn, wrtr_nm, inq_cnt AS inq_cnt, file_uuid, thmb_path AS thmb_path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_BBS_CMNT WHERE CONVERT(SYS_BBS_CMNT.pst_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(SYS_BBS_PST.pst_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS reply_count, sys_crt_usr_id, sys_gen_dt AS sys_crt_dt, sys_mdfr_id AS sys_upd_usr_id, sys_mdfcn_dt AS sys_upd_dt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_BBS_PST( pst_id, bbs_id, ttl, cn, wrtr_nm, inq_cnt, file_uuid, thmb_path, sys_crt_usr_id, sys_gen_dt, sys_mdfr_id, sys_mdfcn_dt ) VALUES( #{pst_id}, #{bbs_id}, #{ttl}, #{cn}, #{wrtr_nm}, 0, #{file_uuid}, #{thmb_path}, #{sys_crt_usr_id}, NOW(), #{sys_upd_usr_id}, NOW() )
